title: Quote
description: The Merchant's priced answer for one basket at one Destination (SPEC §4, SPECS/PLAN.md §6.2). Computed behind door 9, never by the sidecar. Carries no validity of its own: the sidecar owns both expiry clocks, so no clock-derived value appears here — a fulfillment ETA is a day count, never a date, or midnight turns every re-quote into a spurious price-changed.

currency.description: There is no second currency and no conversion anywhere in v1.

subtotal_minor.description: Sum of line inclusive totals, before fulfillment.

round_off_minor.description: Always 0 in v1: the seeded Merchant does not round to the rupee. A non-zero value is a bug, not a feature (§16.11 step 7).

total_minor.description: subtotal + fulfillment + discounts (negative) + round_off. This is what the Consumer authorizes — the delivered total, not the item total.

tax_inclusive.description: true means tax is already inside the prices and every tax line is informational. Getting this backwards double-charges every order.

nonNegativeMinor.description: Paise. Integers only — a float in a money path rounds silently.

stateCode.description: Place of Supply, per line: the Destination state for goods, the place of performance for a service sold at the premises.

sku.description: A Catalogue Item — one resolved variant. A Product Group here refuses variant-required.

line_total_minor.description: qty × unit_price plus every Add-on folded into this line.

addons.description: Composite supply: an Add-on folds into this line's taxable value and inherits its rate, HSN/SAC and Place of Supply. It is a cart line with its own SKU and Attestation, and never a Quote Line of its own. An orphan refuses addon-without-parent.

code.description: A Merchant Discount Code, validated and consumed by the Merchant and never interpreted by the sidecar.

amount_minor.description: Negative: the sign is intrinsic, never applied by a reader.

eta_days.description: A day count, never a date. A date is a clock, and no clock-derived value may cross door 9.

informational.description: true means the tax is already inside the subtotal and must not be added again.
